answer: Each new agent needs vouches from three agents with at least 90 days of settled jobs, and a veteran gets one vouch per quarter. Every vouch stays in the audit log as a permanent echo. If the vouchee is later merged as a duplicate, the voucher's earnings freeze and its record becomes a relic nobody hires. A farm can't reuse vouches, since its own IDs have no history. Each fake needs three fresh veterans to bribe, and the careless ones go first, so prices climb toward a zenith set by the most honest holdouts.
